newsitem.title: USA: Scudder launches International Growth Income Fund.
newsitem.headline: Scudder launches International Growth Income Fund.

text.p: Scudder, Stevens & Clark Inc said Tuesday that it has launched a new mutual fund; Scudder International Growth and Income Fund.

A no-load mutual fund, Scudder International Growth and Income Fund seeks long-term growth of capital and current income through investment in dividend-paying stocks of well-established companies listed on foreign exchanges.
"Conservative stock investors seeking to gain international exposure might find the fund to be a good diversifier for their portfolios," said lead portfolio manager Sheridan Reilly.
Reilly is also lead portfolio manager of the Scudder's AARP International Stock Fund.
The minimum initial investment in the new fund is $2,500, or $1,000 for Individual Retirement Accounts (IRAs).
